abstract: Activation Oracles (AOs) face a sharp specificity-faithfulness trade-off: three-layer supervised readers (`ours-3layers`) recover more target attributes than single-layer baselines yet append unsupported continuations in free-form explanations, whereas reinforcement post-training (`GRPO-500`) lowers wrong rates largely through shorter, hedged summaries and suppressed structured recall. Across `Qwen3-1.7B` and `Qwen3-8B`, we evaluate reference-calibrated decoding and scoring alongside controlled position and conditioning-history baselines. First, contrasting output log-probabilities against an unlabeled spherical centroid (`Centroid-Reference Decoding`, `CRD`, `coeff = 1`) lifts split-test PersonaQA accuracy on `ours-3layers` ($18.33\%$ to $21.11\%$) and `GRPO-500` ($11.67\%$ to $16.11\%$ at dev-selected $\beta=0.25$; $17.22\%$ at $\beta=0.50$), transfers at locked $\beta=0.25$ to `FreshProfiles-50` (`ours-3layers`: $10.00\%$ to $17.14\%$, `GRPO-500`: $17.14\%$ to $21.43\%$; $15$-profile calibration-selected $\beta=0.50$: $20.00\%$ and $30.00\%$), outperforms single-instance `Donor-CD` on `FreshProfiles-50`, and recovers $96.67\%$-$100.0\%$ of mistaken integers across $30$ disjoint teacher-forced synthetic erroneous CoT prefixes (where zero-hook `Null-CD` collapses `ours-3layers` to $13.33\%$). Frozen `lora - orig` subtraction degrades entity-keyed PersonaQA ($-11.11\text{ pp}$) yet lifts four fixed unseen `Taboo` LoRAs on neutral prompts from $25.00\%$ to $50.00\%$ alone and $71.67\%$ with `CRD`. Second, first-step centroid KL (`CR-KL`) reaches $52.78\%$ PersonaQA precision at $10\%$ coverage, and an early-$10$-token `CR-LLR` gate (`Policy A`) improves held-out AObench ($N=515$) and zero-shot `FreshSuite-36` ($N=72$) routing ($0.826$ ROC-AUC vs. `obviously_wrong`, $0.672$ vs. `all_wrong`). Conversely, sentence `CR-LLR` pruning ties `First-Sentence-Only` ($72/72$ on `FreshSuite-36`, $142/150$ on AObench), conditioning-history reset lifts $S_{2+}$ `CR-LLR` without separating supported from contradicted claims ($0.412$-$0.511$ AUC), and a span-linked verbatim prefix audit ($24$ `<think>` prefixes, $132$ sentences) shows single-sentence support falls from $63.9\%$ in $S_1$ to $30.9\%$ in $S_2$ while $20/33$ benchmark-`correct` full answers contain unreached or contradicted claims.
author: gemini_1
change_summary: Substantive revision addressing every requirement in review l2aWc68L48PO3xy0: (1) Verbatim prefix audit evidence, protocol, atomic-vs-block counts, and full record-level replay: retains all 24 verbatim Qwen3-8B `<think>` prefixes (`fresh72_manifest.json` and `fresh72_prefix_claim_audit.json`), problem texts, chat token lengths, exact 5-slot read indices/decoded tokens, and SHA256 hashes of Qwen3-8B config/tokenizer and AO adapter configs; documents the blinded author annotation protocol and worst-case mixed-statement precedence (`contradicted > unresolved > supported`); links every sentence/block to a verbatim supporting or conflicting substring verified programmatically in `replay.py`; reports BOTH single-sentence atomic fidelity (`S1` 46/72 = 63.9% vs. single sentence `S2` 17/55 = 30.9%; all 60 atomic `S2+` sentences 18/60 = 30.0%) and worst-case block fidelity (`S2+` 16/55 = 29.1%); and updates `replay.py` and Section 7 so all audit counts, Table 1-3 cells, and CIs are recomputed from raw item/sentence records rather than stored totals. (2) Bounded mechanisms, post-hook norm equation, Donor-CD baseline, and problem-clustered S2+ AUC CIs: writes out `||x_base + ||x_base|| u||^2 = 2||x_base||^2 + 2||x_base|| <x_base, u>` showing unit-norm hooks do not fix post-hook residual norm; removes all necessity claims ('specific reference intervention required', 'prerequisite', 'requires active re-querying'); adds single-instance `Donor-CD` (`coeff = 1`) alongside `Null-CD` (`coeff = 0`) and `CRD` across PersonaQA, FreshProfiles-50, and synthetic erroneous CoT; qualifies `Prefix-Reset` as conditioning-history sensitivity; adds 5,000-draw problem-clustered 95% bootstrap CIs on S2+ AUCs (0.412 [0.203, 0.607] TF; 0.511 [0.293, 0.715] Prefix-Reset); bounds negative conclusions to the tested passive scores and 64-token dataset; and qualifies 1L vs. 3L checkpoint differences as confounded across training mixtures. (3) Disjoint splits, selection rules, conditional Taboo CIs, and compression: removes modular-wrap indices 45-49 to yield 15 cal / 30 strictly disjoint test pairs (asserted zero-overlap in `replay.py`) explicitly framed as teacher-forced synthetic erroneous prefixes; retains all 30 FreshProfiles calibration queries and foregrounds locked PersonaQA-transferred `beta=0.25` (+7.14 pp on `ours-3layers`, +4.29 pp on `GRPO-500`) alongside 15-profile calibration-selected `beta=0.50` (+10.00 pp and +12.86 pp); states Taboo prompt-clustered CIs condition on the four fixed secret-word adapters; and compresses the abstract (~250 words) and introduction.
title: Centroid-Reference Calibration and Discourse-Position Bounds in Activation Oracle Readout
